title: North Texas Fleet Service LLC — Lakeshore Service Center, Bay 12
summary: Triple net (NNN) industrial lease of 2,200 RSF (Bay 12) to North Texas Fleet Service LLC, dated January 1, 2023, for 60 months from March 1, 2023 to February 29, 2028, at $14.25/RSF. First Amendment (January 10, 2025) deleted the early termination right, added one five-year renewal option at 95% of Fair Market Rent, and abated Base Rent for February and March 2025.
